name: Suou Takako
source:
A woman who came from outside the village to marry Kyoichi Suou. She gave birth to two children, Yukina and Serina, with Kyoichi, but Kyoichi ran away from the village with Serina, and she was left behind in the village. She secretly hates Kyoichi and Serina for abandoning her.

She has a voluptuous body and big breasts. She's also very beautiful.
